places.name: Vrijthof Square
places.ai_summary: A vibrant square in the heart of Maastricht, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and the iconic St. Servatius Basilica.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during festivals or events.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the outdoor cafes.

places.name: St. Pietersberg Caves
places.ai_summary: A network of underground caves and tunnels offering guided tours and insights into Maastricht’s history and geology.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a jacket; it’s cool inside the caves.

attribution.description: View of Albert Canal and the sluices of Petit-Lanaye (Klein-Ternaaien) in Belgium. To the left: Mount Saint Peter (Sint-Pietersberg), South of Maastricht, Netherlands.

places.name: Basilica of Our Lady
places.ai_summary: A stunning Romanesque church featuring beautiful stained glass windows, a serene courtyard, and a rich history.
places.place_tip: Light a candle and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.
places.address: Onze Lieve Vrouweplein 7, 6211 HD Maastricht, Netherlands

attribution.title: OLV-01 (cropped)
attribution.author: Kleon3
attribution.description: Basilica of Our Lady, Maastricht, Netherlands. View of the city.

places.name: Helpoort (Oldest City Gate)
places.ai_summary: The oldest surviving city gate in Maastricht, dating back to the 13th century, now a museum and part of the city’s defenses.
places.place_tip: Combine with a walk on the city walls.

attribution.title: Kent gate, Quebec city, Canada
attribution.author: Wilfredor
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Onze Lieve Vrouweplein Square
places.ai_summary: A picturesque square in front of the Basilica of Our Lady, featuring outdoor cafes and a vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or during events.

places.place_tip: Try the local pastries at nearby cafes.
places.address: Onze Lieve Vrouweplein, 6211 HD Maastricht, Netherlands

attribution.title: Maastricht platz vor liebfrauenkirche
attribution.author: Hans Peter Schaefer, http://www.reserv-a-rt.de

places.name: Maastricht Underground Tunnels
places.ai_summary: A fascinating network of tunnels beneath Maastricht, offering a unique perspective on the city’s history and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours only; book in advance.

places.place_tip: Bring a flashlight and wear warm clothing.

attribution.title: Interieur, overzicht mergelgrot en rechts een muurtekening - Maastricht - 20534289 - RCE
attribution.author: Kris Roderburg
attribution.description: Marl cave / Wall decoration: Interior, overview of the marl cave and a wall drawing on the right

places.name: Markt Square & City Hall
places.ai_summary: The bustling central square of Maastricht, featuring the impressive City Hall and a variety of shops and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Vibrant atmosphere, especially on market days.

places.place_tip: Visit the market on Wednesdays and Fridays.

places.name: Bonnefanten Museum
places.ai_summary: A renowned museum of fine arts, featuring a diverse collection from the Middle Ages to the present day.
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

attribution.title: Rocket-shaped cupola of the Bonnefantenmuseum in Maastricht-Centrum (DSCF7938)
attribution.author: Trougnouf (Benoit Brummer)
attribution.description: Rocket-shaped cupola of the Bonnefantenmuseum in Maastricht-Centrum

places.name: Wyck District
places.ai_summary: A charming neighborhood known for its historic buildings, boutique shops, and the beautiful Maasboulevard.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot; many shops close early.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the sunset view from Maasboulevard.

attribution.author: CmdrDan
attribution.description: Photo of Alvin L. Bragg, Jr., the District Attorney of New York County photographed on Central Park West and 74th Street

places.name: St. Peter’s Fortifications
places.ai_summary: Historical fortifications offering panoramic views of Maastricht and the surrounding area.

places.name: Maas River Cruise
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise on the Maas River, offering beautiful views of Maastricht’s skyline and surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially in summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and a light jacket.

places.name: Dominicanen Bookstore (Church Bookshop)
places.ai_summary: A unique bookstore located in a former church, offering a wide range of books and a cozy reading atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and readings.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the beautiful architecture of the church.

places.name: Centre Céramique Cultural Center
places.ai_summary: A modern cultural center hosting exhibitions, events, and a café, located near the Maas River.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a walk along the Maas River afterwards.

places.name: Kazematten Tunnel Walk
places.ai_summary: An intriguing walk through historical tunnels with information panels about Maastricht’s history.

opening_hours.notes: Self-guided tour; pick up a brochure at the entrance.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby St. Pietersberg Caves.

places.name: Alde Huize Museum
places.ai_summary: A local history museum showcasing Maastricht’s cultural heritage, with exhibits and guided tours.
places.place_tip: Ask about the museum’s special exhibitions.

places.name: Hoge Brug Bridge
places.ai_summary: A modern pedestrian bridge offering stunning views of the Maas River and Maastricht’s skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Take a bike ride across the bridge.

attribution.title: Panorama-bridge2
attribution.author: Ralfrolf
attribution.description: "Hoge brug" (engl: high bridge) in Maastricht.

places.name: Museum aan het Vrijthof
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history and art of Maastricht, located in a former church on the Vrijthof square.
places.place_tip: Explore the museum shop for unique gifts.

attribution.title: Museum aan het Vrijthof - Exterieur 2012
attribution.author: Kleon3
attribution.description: Museum aan het Vrijthof, Maastricht, Netherlands. Exterior 'Spanish Government Building', after the 2011/12 renovation.

places.name: Maastricht Natural History Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the natural history of the Maastricht region, featuring fossils, minerals, and interactive exhibits.
places.place_tip: Visit the fossil exhibit; it’s impressive!

attribution.title: Natuurhistorisch Museum Maastricht
attribution.author: Wilson44691
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Maastricht City Walls Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk along the historic city walls of Maastricht, offering beautiful views and a glimpse into the city’s past.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Start at the Helpoort for a historical overview.
